title: The Lawyer explores emerging disputes trends for 2026
summary: The Lawyer interviews a range of partners, barristers and funders on the key trends they expect to shape the disputes market in 2026. The article includes perspectives from across the legal industry, with CEO Christopher Bogart commenting on increasing complexity in global disputes, the expected legislative response to PACCAR and growing interest in law firm equity solutions. Learn more.
body_markdown:
*The Lawyer* interviews a range of partners, barristers and funders on the key trends they expect to shape the disputes market in 2026. The article includes perspectives from across the legal industry, with CEO[Christopher Bogart](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-bogart/) commenting on increasing complexity in global disputes, the expected legislative response to PACCAR and growing interest in law firm equity solutions.


Read the article[here](https://www.thelawyer.com/its-an-exciting-time-to-be-a-litigator-disputes-lawyers-prepare-for-a-roller-coaster-year/) .
